observations: A large frontal head shape fills most of the canvas, outlined in thick black and white lines against a warm brown field, with one eye rendered as concentric circles and the other as crossed marks inside a dark rounded socket.

Zigzag and wave lines in black, blue, and white run in horizontal bands across the lower half and upper edge, while loose spiral scribbles in yellow and cyan float in the upper-right corner and across the chin area.

The background is divided into flat blocks of orange, purple, pink, and yellow-green, with small rectangular forms stacked on the left edge and a dense cluster of short parallel lines on the right side.
reading: One eye is open wide, ringed in pink and yellow; the other is crossed out. That contrast reads as alertness on one side and refusal on the other. Zigzag bands above and below the head press inward, while loose spirals drift free of the main form. The warm brown field holds the whole arrangement steady, giving the busy surface a grounded, almost contained feeling.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, the title neighbors are nnxyz nnotb #270 and nnxyz nnotb #272. Title order and recorded creation order both place #271 between those two works. The brown ground here contrasts with the deep purple field of #270 and the near-black of #272.

connections.reason: Both works center a large head with exposed teeth and layered scribble lines over flat color blocks, but #270 uses a saturated purple ground and a single large circular eye, while #271 splits the eyes into two distinct treatments against brown.

lookingQuestion: What does the difference between the two eye treatments — one open and ringed, one crossed and closed — do to how you move across the face?
ambiguities: The nifty-faces comparison (QmWShPTyQQ2AZEm7DYAr6grvPbzVg581Vn8btyzNRG8YKY) shares teeth and layered line work but its blocky form and grey ground differ enough that no strong formal connection was identified; it was omitted.
Title order and recorded creation order align here, but gaps may exist elsewhere in the nnotb family, so neither sequence is treated as a complete making chronology.

Comparison with QmagLGbig86KVMxfb9Ns63ofAr7g1W4zDaX8a8hMS4BHDn confirmed: purple ground, single large circular eye, exposed teeth, and layered scribble lines are visible in that image, supporting the stated contrast.
